name: kyoraku-replay
description: Kyoraku Replay — a modern, 100% free, English-default market replay and backtesting workspace with a full pro toolset, real MIT-licensed OHLCV data, trailing stops and partial closes.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && node --check api/ohlcv.js && for f in js/*.js data/catalog.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check tests/run.mjs && node --check tests/api.mjs && node --check tests/browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke
